profile.headline: Technical leader with a strong backend engineering background and extensive experience in data-driven platforms.
profile.summary: Technical leader with a strong backend engineering background and extensive experience in data-driven platforms. Proven track record in microservices, big data analytics, and large-scale data acquisition systems. Experienced in leading engineering teams, managing end-to-end service delivery, and working directly with enterprise and telecom clients. Strong focus on scalable architectures, client integrations, and translating business requirements into reliable technical solutions.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Oversaw the end-to-end technical execution and service delivery of the company’s analytics products, leading engineering and account management teams while acting as the primary technical authority for client-facing engagements.

Key responsibilities
- Led multidisciplinary teams of engineers and account managers to ensure successful delivery, deployment, and operation of analytics products
- Owned service delivery across client projects, ensuring technical quality, timelines, and contractual requirements were met
- Coordinated and oversaw data acquisition systems based on robotic agents collecting data from strategic network points and near end-user devices
- Directed the processing, analysis, and visualization of large-scale data through internal analytics platforms and user interfaces
- Managed the full lifecycle of client integrations, from technical design and deployment to monitoring and continuous improvement
- Acted as the primary technical lead in client meetings, technical workshops, and follow-ups, translating business needs into technical solutions
- Defined priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans across teams to align product capabilities with client requirements

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
Lead the development and delivery of data-driven solutions for telecommunications clients, combining technical leadership, client communication, and advanced backend development in a big data environment.

Key responsibilities
- Acted as the main technical point of contact for telecommunications clients, coordinating requirements, timelines, and project delivery
- Led and managed a backend development team, providing technical guidance, task planning, and performance feedback
- Designed and developed backend microservices and APIs using Java, maintaining continuity with the company’s core platform
- Expanded the use of big data technologies, with a focus on ClickHouse for high-volume analytics and reporting
- Designed and implemented data mapping and ingestion services to integrate client-specific data into the company’s databases and analysis pipelines
- Oversaw MySQL database usage alongside analytical data stores, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability
- Collaborated with product, data, and operations teams to align client solutions with the company’s analytics services

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Developer on a data-intensive platform focused on video streaming and analytics, contributing to the design and development of scalable backend services integrated into the company’s core product.

Key responsibilities
- Designed and developed backend microservices and APIs using Java
- Built and maintained RESTful services to support video data streaming and analysis workflows
- Designed, optimized, and managed MySQL databases, ensuring data integrity, performance, and scalability
- Integrated backend services into the company’s main video analytics product
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align backend solutions with product and business requirements
- Participated in code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization of backend systems

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Company overview
LatitudeN is a technology company developing Android and iOS application that intelligently suggests and optimizes personalized travel experiences for users. The company is member of the European Space Agency (ESA) Technology Transfer Programme.

Role summary
As CTO of an early-stage startup, I led the end-to-end technology strategy and execution for a consumer-facing travel app, balancing strategic decision-making with hands-on development in a fast-paced startup environment.

- Defined and executed the company’s overall technology strategy aligned with business and product goals
- Led project planning, delivery timelines, and cross-functional collaboration in an agile startup setting
- Managed and mentored the development team, overseeing architecture, code quality, and best practices
- Designed and developed backend systems, APIs, and core application logic
- Led website development and deployment, ensuring performance, scalability, and security
- Oversaw the full product lifecycle from concept and MVP to iteration and optimization

positions.title: Projects Manager
positions.description:
Working as a software analyst and project manager in Telespazio, allowed me to get more experience and knowledge in Geographical Information Systems (GIS), to work with different development technologies and also grow as a projects manager.
The main projects I've worked at were:
- Management data system trough web portal (server and client-side) for the gas/electric energy sector.
- Local management solution for the electric energy sector. 
- Google GIS technologies prototypes.
- Real time management system for the military sector.
